verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.cloudflare.com, which hosts the AI Gateway docs. AI Gateway doc pages are also served as markdown index.md variants (e.g., rate-limiting/index.md, fallbacks/index.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: an AI Gateway-specific llms.txt (the probed file is the platform-wide Cloudflare docs index), a working short-form .md variant (/ai-gateway/.md returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
